purpose: Prove Windows interop using absolute PowerShell path and discover exact Windows Startup folder/distro from BLACK.
command:
set -e
PS=/mnt/c/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe
"$PS" -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command '$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"; $startup=[Environment]::GetFolderPath("Startup"); $distros=@(& wsl.exe -l -q) | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ }; [ordered]@{ state="WINDOWS_INTEROP_OK"; windows_user=$env:USERNAME; startup=$startup; distros=$distros; ps_version=$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString() } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress'
